thread:
Iris: Quick cross-org pulse  vendors surfaced slightly different ETAs for Gaudi (APAC) and MI300 (EU). We need a short, operational playbook so marketplace flips don't cause press or OEM confusion.
Ken: Agreed. Two main requirements: 1) SI cert + perf gate per region, 2) a clear press-go handshake with partners.
Marta: SI: Gaudi APAC kernel hotfix ETA +8-11 days. MI300 EU perf micropatch ETA +3 days. H100/H200/B200 unaffected.
Owen: Ops POV: propose a "circuit-breaker" pattern on the marketplace gate. If error_rate > 2% or perf_drop >10% during canary -> auto-rollback to "limited" state.
Iris: Love the circuit-breaker idea. Let's define the states:
- coming-soon (no traffic)
- limited (marketplace card shows region badge, opt-in canaries)
- available (public, press-go required)

Marta: SI will emit a webhook per cert event. Suggested payload fields: sku, region, cert_ts, pass_rate, blocking_issues, suggested_stability_window. We'll attach a cert_id.
Ken: Runbook sketch for ops (short):
```
1) wait SI.cert == true && pass_rate >= 95%
2) flip SKU to limited and start 48h announce-canary (1% traffic)
3) monitor metrics: latency, error_rate, model_quality
4) if metrics within thresholds -> mark marketplace_ready
5) Comms does partner/press handshake -> set press-go
6) if circuit-breaker trips -> rollback to limited and notify partners
```
Owen: Threshold suggestions: error_rate < 1.5%, avg_latency within SLO + 12%, model_quality regression < 1% on eval set. Circuit-breaker window 10m with 5min rolling.
CommsLead: Partner rules: vendors must not publish "global availability". Press-go requires legal + partner sign-off. We'll centralize partner quotes in a single doc to avoid mismatches.
Iris: Can we add a small "partner-handshake" webhook: partner_ack = {partner, sku, region, quote_confirmed:true}? That way we can gate press-go.
Marta: SI can add partner_ack to the integration flow. We'll include a cert_ts and optional notes.
Ken: Ops tasks: implement marketplace_gate feature flag, circuit-breaker hook, canary tag "announce_canary=true", and UI statuses. Also allocate dedicated canary pools: 2x APAC, 1x EU.
Owen: Infra ticket PART-5500 created by PartnerBot: "allocate canary pools for HW announce". Assigned to infra-oncall.
CommsLead: I'll draft two embargo templates: "region-limited" and "wave-release" and circulate by EOD. Also recommend we schedule press-go deadline 72h after marketplace_ready to allow partner edits.
Iris: Minor nuance: when we rollback because of vendor-side fixes, we must include a short public note: "availability delayed due to driver stability; investigating."

Ken: Runtime fallback plan: if H100 latency exceeds SLO by threshold, route new requests to B200-quantized variant with header X-Fallback:quant. Telemetry event fallback.count increments.
Marta: SI will provide a pass_rate field on webhook and a stability_window suggested timestamp. We'll rely on that to start the 48h canary.
Iris: Action list recap:
- Marta -> publish per-region cert webhooks + cert_id + pass_rate (EOD)
- Ken/Owen -> implement marketplace_gate + circuit-breaker + canary pools PART-5500 (tomorrow)
- CommsLead -> embargo templates + partner handshake wording (EOD)
- PartnerBot -> create central partner-quote doc and invite vendors (now)

PartnerBot: Calendar: follow-up sync "Marketplace Gate + Partner Handshake" scheduled 2026-05-03 09:00 UTC. Ticket PART-5500 created.
Marta: We'll post the kernel hotfix ETA update in this thread when available. If it slips further we'll recommend delaying APAC public announce and keep canary-only.
Iris: Thanks team. Small ask: if any partner starts external comms before press-go, escalate to me and CommsLead immediately.
